text: This report recommends the adoption by City Council of interim 2024 Solid Waste Management Services (SWMS) Rates and Fees as set out in this report. The adoption of these interim rates and fees is requested in advance of the 2024 Tax and Rate Supported Operating and Capital Budgets to establish these rates and service fees and provide City staff with the necessary authority to implement them effective January 1, 2024. The proposed interim rates are consistent with the 10-year financial modeling and annual rate increase requirements presented during the 2023 Budget process. The interim rates may be amended by City Council when the 2024 Rate Supported Operating and Capital Budgets are approved, which is expected in Quarter 1 of 2024.
